svg.title: Dense Accuracy
svg.desc: Mean normalized 3D reconstruction error for Ours, OPM and TSM on the four dense face sequences. Lower is better. Linear axis starting at zero. Main paper Table 5, page 7. The three methods match the accompanying runtime comparison; all source-table methods are in the downloadable data.

ns2:Work.dc:description: Mean normalized 3D reconstruction error for Ours, OPM and TSM on the four dense face sequences. Lower is better. Linear axis starting at zero. Main paper Table 5, page 7. The three methods match the accompanying runtime comparison; all source-table methods are in the downloadable data.
